source.base: Declared BEFORE S4 scoring: canonical relation -> acceptable [emission surface, flipped] pairs. flipped=true means the stated triple's subject/object are swapped relative to the canonical head/tail. Transcribed mechanically from the research copy (ontology-scale-test/s4/gold_mapping.json); this artefact is now the shipped declaration.
source.additions: Density program Test A (2026-11-01): 14 pairs, origin 'density_test_a', each carrying its justification. Measured on the A-final stack: raw lenient recall 0.4551 -> 0.5150 (+54 gold rows, 0 lost); the gain is the declaration catching up with the pack's actual emission conventions, not an extraction change.
source.vocabulary_and_write: 0.1.4 scope freeze items 5-6 (2026-11-01): declared emission vocabulary with no canonical counterpart, and the WRITE canonicalization of the parent/child dual.

declarations.canonical: located in the administrative territorial entity
located in the administrative territorial entity
located in or next to body of water
located in or next to body of water

declarations.justification: 'participant in' with the participant as subject denotes the participation relation; gold 'participant' rows orient from the participant (head=person, tail=event). The same stack shape is already declared acceptable for 'participant of' read the other way.
Gold 'conflict' rows are participation rows (head = the participant, tail = the conflict event); 'participant in' with the participant as subject denotes exactly that fact.

'performed by' is the passive naming of the performer relation with the work as subject; the mapping already declares ('performed by', False) acceptable for 'notable work'. Gold 'performer' orients head=work.
Gold 'creator' orients head=work, tail=creator; (work, 'written by', person) denotes exactly that authorship fact.
Gold 'author' rows in this corpus orient head=work, tail=author; (work, 'written by', person) denotes it.
(publication, 'published by', person) read person-ward denotes the publisher relation; parallel to the declared ('written by', True) entries for creator/author.

Gold 'mother' orients head=child, tail=mother. (mother, 'parent of', child) read child-ward denotes it; the tail name match picks out the mother specifically (the declared mapping already uses gender-neutral parent carriers for mother/father).
(child, 'child of', mother) denotes the mother relation directly; missing twin of the declared ('child of', True) which serves parent-headed gold relations.
Same as mother: (father, 'parent of', child) read child-ward denotes gold (child, 'father', father).
Same as mother: (child, 'child of', father) denotes it.
A subordinate being 'part of' an organization denotes the parent-organization relation from the subordinate side; gold orients head=subordinate.
Inverse view of the same organizational parthood: (subordinate, 'part of', parent) read parent-ward denotes gold (parent, 'subsidiary', subordinate).
A work being 'part of' a series IS the series relation; gold orients head=work.
'married to' is symmetric: endpoint order carries no meaning, both orders denote the identical fact. The declared entry accepts only gold's arbitrary order.

vocabulary_note: Emission surfaces attested in the stack (11 triples) that denote no canonical relation in the inventory. Declared as first-class vocabulary - the declaration widens instead of the emission narrowing, because all four state text-grounded facts (formation by merger, naming commemoration, teaching, military command). At WRITE each is its own canonical form.

write_canonicalizations.note: The one true inverse pair in the emission inventory. 'child of' is canonical (emission dominance 27 vs 19 in the measured stack); a triple stated as (parent, 'parent of', child) is stored as (child, 'child of', parent). Measured score-neutral both ways; the product gain is consistency - the stack stated every parent fact twice, once under each dual (19-21 duplicate pairs removed). One declaration; reversing it is a one-line change here.

NOT added: same doc18 anomaly as above.
NOT added: 'notable work' carries selective semantics (notability) - fan-out to it would manufacture claims the text does not make.
NOT added: same selective-semantics reason as above.
NOT added: semantically parallel to ('written by', False) but no gold creator row corresponds to either 'developed by' emission in this corpus - untestable mapping surface.
